subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and should its public API be Slack-style thread.requireExplicitMention, a per-channel requireMentionInThreadReplies option, or part of the broader parent/thread override design?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API or default behavior.

options.title: Add Opt-In Explicit Thread Replies
options.body: Add a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fold Into Parent/Thread Override
options.body: Resolve this together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75938, accepting that starter-versus-follow-up semantics may need an additional rule.

options.title: Keep Current Continuation
options.body: Decline a new Discord config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mentions.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Explicit Thread Replies
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared mention policy, Discord preflight routing, and config compatibility, where steipete has the strongest recent history.
